Prof. Govind Negalur is an Assistant Professor in the Computer Science & Engineering department at SDMCET, Dharwad. He completed his B.E. in 2007 and M.Tech in 2014, both from SDMCET Dharwad. He has guided many UG and PG students, conducted several workshops, and published 3 papers in international journals/conferences (topics include a cloud-based learning environment, IoT with Cloud, trust-based matrix factorization for recommendations, and EEG-based driver drowsiness detection). He has given FDP/student workshops on Cloud Computing, IoT and LaTeX across colleges in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Goa. Phone: 974 014 3982. Email: govind.negalur@sdmcet.ac.in. In the 1st semester CS B Div timetable he is the instructor for Introduction to AI and its Application.

Dr. Rani Shetty is an Assistant Professor in the Computer Science & Engineering department at SDMCET, Dharwad. She completed her B.E. in 2012 from REC College, Hulkoti, and her Master's in 2014 from SDMCET Dharwad (Qualifications: B.E., M.Tech, Ph.D.). She has guided many UG and PG students, published 3 papers in international journals/conferences, and is the Faculty Advisor for the IEEE Women in Engineering Affinity Group. She has been a resource person for an FDP on 'E-Content Creation' at SDMCET and for a talk on 'Digital India' organized by Rotary Club, Dharwad. Phone: 973 882 7107. Email: ranishetty1990@sdmcet.ac.in. In the 1st semester CS B Div timetable she is the instructor for Principles of C Programming.

Prof. Kavya K Kajagar is an Assistant Professor in the Electrical and Electronics Engineering department at SDMCET, Dharwad. She completed her B.E. in Electrical & Electronics from Tontadarya College of Engineering, Gadag, and her Master's in Electrical Power System from SDMCET Dharwad (Qualifications: B.E., M.Tech). She joined on 30-09-2024 on a contractual basis and is UG faculty, with 1 national/international conference paper and 1 national/international journal paper. Phone: 8867882293 or 0836-2328337 (Ext. 8337). Email: kavyakajagar21@gmail.com. In the 1st semester CS B Div timetable she is the instructor for Introduction to Electrical Engineering.

Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Semester I, Division B, ODD Academic Year 2026-27 (effective from 03-08-2026). Classes run from morning to about 5:00 PM with a tea break in the morning and a lunch break in the afternoon, and Saturday has the Mathematics (26UMATCS11) lab. Please check the official timetable notice from the CSE department for exact day-wise slots and room numbers. The timetable is signed by the HOD CSE, Dean (Academic Program) and Principal.

patterns: What subjects are in 1st semester CS
who teaches which subject in CS B
intents.answer: Semester I (CS stream, Div B, total 20 credits): 26UMATCS11 Mathematics-I for CS Stream (4 credits, Dr Prakash Badiger); 26UCHECS12 Chemistry for CS Stream (4 credits, Dr Asma Tatagar); 26UPCP13 Principles of C Programming (3 credits, Dr Rani Shetty); 26UESC141 Introduction to Electrical Engineering (3 credits, Prof. Kavya); 26UETC151 Introduction to AI and its Application (3 credits, Prof. Govind Negalur); 26UPWS16 Professional Writing Skills in English (1 credit, Dr Shashikant Kurodi); 26UICO17 Indian Constitution (1 credit, Prof. M P Vastrad); 26UBEC18 Biology for Engineers (1 credit, Prof. Tanveer Ahmed).
